# bombyx

> Drive isolated AI-agent VMs on a remote libvirt host
> over SSH. Rust CLI, derived from the rustbase template.

## Project Structure

Cargo workspace, CLI only:

- `crates/bombyx` — core library and CLI binary
  - `config.rs` — `bombyx.toml` parsing, validation, paths
  - `name.rs` — validated `ScratchName` (one path segment)
  - `remote.rs` — ssh/scp/tar command construction (pure)
  - `plan.rs` — `Action` → ordered command list
  - `bin/bombyx/main.rs` — clap parsing, thin dispatch
- `xtask` — build automation (not published)

No web crate, no frontend, no E2E suite, no deploy
subsystem — those were removed from the template.

## Model

bombyx never manages VMs directly. It pushes a project's
`vagrant/` directory to the VM host and runs `vagrant`
there over SSH. The project repo is the source of truth;
the host holds a cache refreshed on every `up`.

## Commands

```
bombyx up                 # push vagrant/, boot the VM
bombyx down               # halt the VM
bombyx shell              # shell inside the VM (ssh -t)
bombyx status             # vagrant status
bombyx reset              # restore fresh-install snapshot
bombyx scratch <name>     # boot a throwaway VM
bombyx discard <name>     # destroy a throwaway VM
```

Global flags: `--config <path>` (default `bombyx.toml`),
`--dry-run` (print the argv instead of running it).

## Configuration

`bombyx.toml` in the project root:

```toml
host = "frosti"          # required, SSH alias
project = "phren"        # required
vagrant_dir = "vagrant"  # optional
remote_root = "~/vms"    # optional
```

## Build Commands

```
cargo xtask validate          # fmt + clippy + tests + coverage + dupes + audit
cargo xtask check             # fast compile-only check
cargo xtask test [filter]     # tests only
cargo xtask clippy            # lint only
cargo xtask fmt               # format code
cargo xtask coverage          # coverage check (>=90% workspace, >=85% per module)
cargo xtask dupes             # duplication check (<=6%)
cargo xtask audit             # RUSTSEC advisories
```

`cargo xtask validate` is the canonical gate (7 steps);
all commits and the Stop hook run it. Never use raw
`cargo test` / `cargo clippy`.

## Conventions

- Rust edition 2024, 80-column code and markdown
- `thiserror` in the library, `anyhow` in the binary
- `#[forbid(unsafe_code)]`, clippy pedantic, zero warnings
- Logic lives in the library: `src/bin/` is excluded from
  coverage, so code there ships untested
- `remote.rs` builds commands but never spawns processes,
  which is what keeps it testable without a VM host
- `bombyx.toml` ships inside a repo, so it is untrusted:
  every field is validated against an allowlist. `host`
  reaching `ssh` as `-oProxyCommand=...` would be local RCE
- Remote paths go through `quote_remote_path`, which leaves
  a leading `~` outside the quotes — a POSIX shell does not
  expand `~` inside single quotes

## Claude Code Skills

| Skill | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `/check` | Fast compile-only check |
| `/test` | Run tests with agent-friendly output |
| `/validate` | Full quality pipeline |
| `/commit` | Commit with diary, CHANGELOG, code reviews |
| `/release` | Cut a SemVer release |
| `/retrospect` | Workflow retrospective |
| `/todo` | Capture a work item into `docs/todo.md` |
| `/implement` | Plan + execute a captured item |
| `/architect` | Architecture guide |
| `/template-sync` | Pull upstream rustbase improvements |
| `/template-improve` | Log feedback about the template |
